description: This plugin allows you to harness the power of AI while working with your GoCodes Asset & Inventory data. Now you can use AI chat to answer questions like 'Where's my nearest compressor?', 'What tasks do I need to work on today?' and much more. On your smartphone you can now talk to GoCodes using just your voice ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Show me a list of my assets
Are any checked out assets overdue
Create a summary table of my different asset types
